summary: E2E validation of MAZIGHO Lot B (advanced promo codes, abandoned carts, email templates) and Lot C (client orders + returns, admin returns/RMA with refund gating, live SEO preview, RBAC, audit log) plus Lot A regression. Backend: 24/24 non-skipped tests passing (2 skips due to missing seed data — no abandoned carts and no paid orders in local DB, both properly documented graceful-degradation paths). Frontend: full admin login now works purely via UI (previous SameSite=None cookie bug from iteration_2 is FIXED — cookie is now SameSite=Lax and Chromium accepts it). All required data-testid attributes are present. Promo scope logic (all/first_order/category), category-select conditional visibility, per-user limit, scope badges in list, checkout promo apply/remove with discount line + French error for invalid code, email template CRUD with persistence, live SEO preview (Google + social), abandoned carts email-not-configured warning, RBAC (order_operator can access /admin/retours but the 'Rembourser' button is correctly hidden; /admin/promotions correctly denied with 'Accès réservé'), and audit-log records (seo.update, email_template.update, promotion.create, promotion.delete) all VERIFIED working.

features_verified.lotB_promotions_admin: PASS - /admin/promotions loads. 'Nouveau code' modal exposes data-testids: promo-scope-select, promo-category-select (conditionally rendered), promo-peruser-input. Scope options: 'Tout le panier', 'Réservé au 1er achat', 'Une catégorie précise'. Choosing 'Une catégorie précise' reveals the category dropdown; switching back to any other scope hides it. Per-user limit persists. List shows scope badge ('1er achat') and per-user limit ('2/client') on the created row. Create/update/delete via tRPC (admin.promotions.*) all return 200 and category-scope without categoryId returns BAD_REQUEST 'Sélectionnez une catégorie pour ce code ciblé.'.
features_verified.lotB_checkout_promo_apply: PASS - /commander (real customer checkout route; note the task description said '/checkout' which is 404 — the actual route is '/commander') shows data-testid checkout-promo-input and checkout-apply-promo. Applying TEST10 (10% active) reduced 16.00 CHF → 14.40 CHF, added 'Réduction (TEST10) −1.60 CHF' line, showed checkout-applied-promo badge with X button (checkout-remove-promo), and toast 'Code TEST10 appliqué'. Applying an unknown code shows French error 'Code promo invalide ou désactivé'. shop.promotions.validate mutation returns discountAmount when authenticated as a user with no prior paid orders (first_order scope).
features_verified.lotB_abandoned_carts: PASS - /admin/paniers-abandonnes loads with warning banner 'Le service e-mail n'est pas encore configuré. Ajoutez RESEND_API_KEY et MAZIGHO_EMAIL_FROM sur Vercel…', stats cards (Paniers concernés / Valeur potentielle / Seuil d'inactivité), marketing-hours-select present, empty state 'Aucun panier abandonné'. admin.marketing.abandonedCarts returns {carts:[], emailConfigured:false}. sendCartReminder graceful-fail path NOT exercised (no carts to target locally); flagged as skipped, not a bug.
features_verified.lotB_email_templates: PASS - /admin/emails renders three tabs (Confirmation de commande / Expédition / Panier abandonné) via data-testid email-tab-*. Editing subject on order_confirmation and clicking email-save-order_confirmation shows toast 'Modèle enregistré'. Reload verifies persistence via admin.emailTemplates.getAll (template.subject == new value). Variable chips ({{prenom}}, {{commande}}, {{total}}, {{lignes}}) are visible below the body. audit.log records 'email_template.update' action.
features_verified.lotC_client_orders: PASS - /commandes loads for a logged-in user. shop.orders.getMyOrders returns an array. shop.orders.requestReturn returns 404 'Commande introuvable.' for missing order, 400 for reasons shorter than 5 chars (zod validation). The 'Demander un retour' UI dialog + tracking badge could not be exercised end-to-end because there are no paid orders in the local DB (documented seed gap, not a bug).
features_verified.lotC_admin_returns_RMA_and_RBAC: PASS - /admin/retours accessible to admin AND to order_operator (RBAC allowed); catalog_editor is forbidden (403 'Accès réservé à cette mission.'). admin.orders.refund is admin-only (order_operator returns 403 'You do not have required permission (10002)'), matching the 'Rembourser' button being HIDDEN in the order_operator UI (0 refund-return-* elements visible). Stats cards (Demandes à traitier / Total demandes / Remboursées) present. Empty state 'Aucune demande de retour' shown (no returns in DB). Approve/Reject/Refund confirmation-text gating and timeline modal could not be exercised without a paid order + return in the DB — documented seed gap, not a bug.
features_verified.lotC_live_SEO_preview: PASS - /admin/seo has data-testid seo-preview-card with a Google search-result preview and a social-share preview. Typing in seo-title-input updates the preview live (verified 'E2E LIVE <ts>' appears in the Google preview card). Save via seo-save-button persists (verified reload). Title >70 chars is rejected by zod. audit records 'seo.update'.
features_verified.audit_log_regression: PASS - /admin/audit journal lists actions (28 entries at time of test) including recent 'seo.update', 'email_template.update', 'promotion.create', 'promotion.delete', 'promotion.update' entries generated by this run.

action_items: Optional: the request mentions '/checkout' as an alias route but the real customer checkout is served at '/commander'. If E1 wants '/checkout' to also work (per the docs), add a redirect Route in App.tsx. Otherwise update the requirement text.

Optional (for future testing hardening): provide a seed/DB helper to create a fake paid order + return so refund graceful-error, tracking badge, approve/reject flow, and timeline modal can be exercised in CI without a real Stripe checkout.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie SameSite issue from iteration_2 is FIXED (server now emits SameSite=Lax over http). Good.

adminRouter.promotions.create validates scope='category' requires categoryId but the client-side 'Une catégorie précise' UI allows saving without a chosen category — the server correctly returns BAD_REQUEST but the UI could gate the Save button while the select is at 'Choisir une catégorie…' for a smoother UX.
shop.orders.requestReturn correctly maps ORDER_NOT_FOUND/NOT_PAID/ALREADY_OPEN to French user errors — nice pattern.

admin.orders.refund correctly guards with adminProcedure so order_operator cannot invoke it; UI mirrors this by not rendering refund-return-* buttons for non-admin — verified server-side + client-side.

Two skipped E2E paths (sendCartReminder graceful email failure and admin.orders.refund graceful Stripe failure) both need seed data (an abandoned cart with a userEmail, and a paid order). Would recommend adding a scripted seed for CI.
